name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 6 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 46 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.0 days starting 2025-12-15, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
